description: What the Kinetica exporter has written to its metric tables: metrics, series, labels and ingest volume.

options.content:
### Inventory
The metrics, series and labels in the metric tables, and the points written. Needs the Kinetica datasource plugin 1.1.0 or later, and the series and point tables (`metric_series`, `metric_*_point`) the latest Kinetica OpenTelemetry exporter writes, in the schema chosen above. The service filter applies to everything but the points written, which the point tables do not record per service.

panels.title: Metrics
panels.description: Every metric, with its number of series and services.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric_name, metric_type, unit,
       COUNT(*) AS series,
       COUNT(DISTINCT service_name) AS services,
       MIN(first_seen) AS first_seen
FROM $schema.metric_series
WHERE $__labelMatch(labels, 'service.name', ${service:json})
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, unit
ORDER BY series DESC, metric_name

panels.title: Series per service
panels.description: Series and metrics of each service (service.name).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(service_name, '(none)') AS service,
       COUNT(*) AS series,
       COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS metric_names
FROM $schema.metric_series
WHERE $__labelMatch(labels, 'service.name', ${service:json})
GROUP BY COALESCE(service_name, '(none)')
ORDER BY series DESC

panels.title: Label keys
panels.description: Every label key, with the number of series having it: the cardinality to watch.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label, COUNT(*) AS series
FROM UNNEST_JSON_OBJECT(SELECT labels FROM $schema.metric_series WHERE $__labelMatch(labels, 'service.name', ${service:json})) t(label, label_value)
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY series DESC, label

panels.title: Points written
panels.description: Rows written to each point table per time bucket, for every service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval) AS time, 'number' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM $schema.metric_number_point
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_unix)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval)
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval) AS time, 'histogram' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM $schema.metric_histogram_point
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_unix)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval)
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval) AS time, 'exp_histogram' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM $schema.metric_exp_histogram_point
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_unix)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval)
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval) AS time, 'summary' AS point_table, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM $schema.metric_summary_point
WHERE $__timeFilter(time_unix)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(time_unix, $__interval)

panels.title: New series per hour
panels.description: Series seen for the first time, per metric type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroup(first_seen, 1h) AS time, metric_type, COUNT(*) AS new_series
FROM $schema.metric_series
WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen)
  AND $__labelMatch(labels, 'service.name', ${service:json})
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(first_seen, 1h), metric_type
ORDER BY time
